user_query: I'm organizing a music festival and I need your help. Can you fetch the last fresh result of a popular song? Additionally, provide me with a random quote in English and a random Lithuanian joke to entertain the attendees. It would be great if you could fetch the popular songs in the Iceland Songs chart and also provide information about the greatest of all time Billboard 200 Albums.

Retrieve a random quote in English.

Fetch the popular songs from the Iceland Songs chart.
